# Short Native Media Evidence — 30 Seconds Closed

The Awtsmoos renews every frame while Awtsmoos.com asks evidence to stand on more than one leg: browser completion, native probe, full decode, frame cardinality, image witnesses, and audible signal all agree.

## Browser completion
- Canonical proof duration: 30 seconds.
- Geometry: 640×360.
- Frame rate: 12fps.
- Browser-reported completed frames: 360/360.
- Native backend: `native-ffmpeg-libx264`.
- Final Blob: 3,528,351 bytes, `video/mp4`.
- Browser soundtrack included one prepared spoken clip in the 30-second window.

## Independent native verification
- File: `media/awtsmoos-ai-canonical-30000ms-ffmpeg-proof.mp4`.
- ffprobe video: H.264, 640×360, 12/1 fps, exactly 360 decoded frames.
- ffprobe audio: AAC, 48,000 Hz, stereo.
- Container duration: exactly 30.000000 seconds.
- Full ffmpeg decode to null completed with exit code 0.

## Encoded frame witnesses
- 1s SHA-256: `7b542f553d746e14d65da24e199f35f379863ebbe899541f62b22a3b50daa7aa`.
- 15s SHA-256: `854920aa1fced65f6f9d18637d6670aa56d69440e570a9b5e8ac82af4e36c0ff`.
- 29s SHA-256: `90014b18c24d2f2f3382c8c182a956e05bb5ebee8281475fbeca18e83dc8fef2`.
- All three hashes differ, proving distant encoded images are not byte-identical.
- Chrome screenshot capture failed twice, including on a normal HTML wrapper around the image. Therefore no qualitative visual description is claimed from this tool path.

## Audio evidence
- Whole 30-second audio mean volume: approximately −23.8 dB.
- Whole audio max volume: approximately −4.0 dB.
- First 15 seconds mean volume: approximately −29.6 dB.
- First 15 seconds max volume: approximately −22.4 dB.
- The soundtrack is demonstrably non-silent.

## Performance evidence
- Completed localhost frame POSTs averaged about 49 ms across 140 measured requests.
- Most recent 20 frame POSTs averaged about 35 ms.
- Therefore localhost upload is not the dominant cost; browser Canvas rendering/JPEG production dominates the short proof.
- The current frame pump is intentionally sequential and is now proven correct through 360 frames.

## REMAINING_WORK
1. Full 180-second / 2,160-frame render.
2. Full independent ffprobe and decode.
3. Seven distant encoded frame witnesses and best-effort qualitative inspection through any functioning visual path.
4. Audio-window evidence for both Miriam and Teacher.
5. Mobile director/browser verification, broader tests, hygiene, docs, delta, handoff, and hidden-work discovery.

## NEXT_ACTION
Plan and execute the full render path without weakening 640×360/12fps or the browser-authoritative semantic renderer.
